note: spring5-security-batch: AntPathRequestMatcher is gone in Security 7 → PathPatternRequestMatcher.pathPattern — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|AntPathRequestMatcher` (8e787ba7f1)
response:
<analysis>Spring Security 7 removed AntPathRequestMatcher; PathPatternRequestMatcher.pathPattern(HttpMethod, String) / pathPattern(String) replace it. The script rewrites `new AntPathRequestMatcher(url)` and `new AntPathRequestMatcher(url, method)` (method a String that may be null → any method) and swaps the import.</analysis>
<script>
import re

OLD_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.security.web.util.matcher.AntPathRequestMatcher;"
NEW_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.security.web.servlet.util.matcher.PathPatternRequestMatcher;"
METHOD_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;"
TWO = re.compile(r"new\s+AntPathRequestMatcher\(\s*([^,()]+?)\s*,\s*([^,()]+?)\s*\)")
ONE = re.compile(r"new\s+AntPathRequestMatcher\(\s*([^,()]+?)\s*\)")

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = TWO.sub(lambda m: f"({m.group(2)} == null ? PathPatternRequestMatcher.pathPattern({m.group(1)}) : "
                                f"PathPatternRequestMatcher.pathPattern(HttpMethod.valueOf({m.group(2)}), {m.group(1)}))",
                      text)
        new = ONE.sub(r"PathPatternRequestMatcher.pathPattern(\1)", new)
        if new == text:
            p.log(f"{path}: no AntPathRequestMatcher constructor found")
            continue
        new = new.replace(OLD_IMPORT, NEW_IMPORT)
        if "HttpMethod.valueOf(" in new and METHOD_IMPORT not in new:
            new = new.replace(NEW_IMPORT, METHOD_IMPORT + "\n" + NEW_IMPORT, 1)
        p.write(path, new)
        p.log(f"{path}: AntPathRequestMatcher -> PathPatternRequestMatcher.pathPattern")
</script>
